requisitionDescription:
About Us: 

Established in 2002, General Fusion is a global leader in the race to commercialize clean fusion energy. We are pursuing a uniquely practical approach, Magnetized Target Fusion, and aim to provide zero-carbon fusion power to the grid in the early to mid-2030s. Today at our state-of-the-art labs in Richmond, BC, we’re operating a groundbreaking fusion demonstration machine called Lawson Machine 26 (LM26)...

Position Overview:

General Fusion is seeking a Senior Electronics Engineer to join our Controls & Electronics team. ...

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the electronics group's technical authority on analog and digital design, signal integrity, and measurement methodology. 
  • Own the hardware development lifecycle from requirements through schematic design, PCB layout, prototyping, test, and release.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent. 
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience designing, deploying, and commissioning electronic systems in R&D, scientific, or industrial environments. 

The typical hiring range for this position is $140,000 - $170,000.
